x-e-e4-01.title: Qoraalka Hooyo iyo waqtiga ciyaarta Jisu
x-e-e4-01.goal: Isbarbar dhig dhowr qorshe ee qoraalka Hooyo iyo waqtiga uu saaxiib soo jeediyey, hel halka aysan ku habboonayn, oo Ingiriisi ku dheh maya adigoo soo jeedinaya waqti kale.
x-e-e4-01.material:
Qoraal Hooyo ka tagtay miiska (oo qoraal keliya ah, sawir la'aan):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Kadib saaxiibkeed Jisu wuxuu soo diray fariin qoraal ah. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"
x-e-e4-01.thinking.0: Isbarbar dhig waqtiyada qoraalka iyo heerka waqtiga la soo jeediyey, mid mid
x-e-e4-01.thinking.1: Xukun haddii 'heer' waqti iyo hal waqti ay is dul dhacaan
x-e-e4-01.thinking.2: Ku sheeg Ingiriisi, adigoo bixinaya caddaynta
x-e-e4-01.prereq.0: Macnaha p.m. iyo akhrinta waqtiyada (sida 3:30 iyo 4:00)
x-e-e4-01.prereq.1: Erayo fudud sida piano class iyo trash
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.prompt: Dooro dhammaan xariiqaha qoraalka ee waqtiga ku dul dhacaya soo jeedinta Jisu (4:15-5:15).
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.hint.0: Xariiq kasta geli waqtiga beerta '4:15-5:15' agtiisa mid mid, oo eeg haddii uu dhammaado ka hor ama bilaabmo kadib.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.hint.1: Waxyaabaha waqti qaata, sida fasal, xisaabi waqtiga ay dhammaadaan.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.a: Isbarbar dhig haddii waqtiga aad guriga timaado uu ka horeeyo ama ka dambeeyo 4:15.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.b: Xisaabi waqtiga casharku bilaabmo iyo waqtiga uu dhammaado, oo geli waqtiga beerta agtiisa.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.c: Waxaan u malaynayay inay tahay hubinta haddii hal waqti uu ku dhacayo gudaha heerka waqtiga beerta.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.d: Isbarbar dhig haddii waqtiga casuumaadu ka dambeeyo marka waqtiga beertu dhammaado.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.explain: Casharka biyaanada waa 4:00-4:30, sidaas darteed 4:15-4:30 ayaa is dul dhaca, soo saaridda qashinku 5:00-na wuxuu ku dhacayaa 4:15-5:15 gudihiisa. Imaanshaha guriga 3:30 iyo casuumaadda 6:30 waxay ka baxsan yihiin waqtiga beerta.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.prompt: Jisu u jawaab laba ama saddex weedhood oo Ingiriisi ah. Qoraalka ka hel sababaha aadan u tegi karin, qor, oo soo jeedi hal waqti kale oo shaqeeya.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore, dheh maya hal weedh adigoo isticmaalaya 'Sorry, I can't ...'.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.hint.1: Qor labada qorshe ee is dul dhacaya ee qoraalka iyo waqtiyadooda, dhammaadkana soo jeedintaada ku samee 'Can we play at ...?'.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma bixisay labada sabab, biyaanada iyo soo saaridda qashinka?
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma soo jeediyey waqti kale, waqtigaasna ma is dul dhacaa qorshayaasha qoraalka?
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Weedh diidmo ah sida 'I can't' ma jirtaa?
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Jawaab wanaagsan oo soo jeedisay waqtiga sida heer.

x-e-e4-02.title: Go'aami waqtiyada socodka eyga iyo shaqada guriga
x-e-e4-02.goal: Samee dhowr isku-darka kala duwan ee waqtiga socodka iyo waqtiga shaqada guriga oo buuxiya dhammaan shuruudaha qoraalka Aabbo.
x-e-e4-02.material:
Qoraal Aabbo ka tagay (oo qoraal keliya ah, sawir la'aan):

Mina,
You come home at 4:00 p.m. I come home at 6:30 p.m.
- Walk the dog for 30 minutes. Not before 5:00 p.m. It is too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.
- Finish both before I come home.
- Do not do both at the same time.

Hoose, waqti kasta u qor sida 'daqiiqado imisa kadib 4:00 p.m.'. Tusaale ahaan, haddii aad bilowdo 4:30, qor 30, haddii aad bilowdo 5:15-na qor 75.
x-e-e4-02.thinking.0: Naftaada u samee jawaab buuxisa dhowr shuruudood isla markiiba
x-e-e4-02.thinking.1: Waqtiga ay qaadato ku dar waqtiga bilowga si aad u hubiso waqtiga dhammaadka
x-e-e4-02.thinking.2: Hubi haddii ay is dul dhacaan
x-e-e4-02.prereq.0: Akhrinta waqtiyada iyo ku darista daqiiqado
x-e-e4-02.prereq.1: Erayo fudud sida walk the dog iyo homework
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.prompt: Haddii Mina ay bilowdo shaqada guriga 5:00 iyo socodka 5:30, shuruudda kee ee qoraalka ayay jebisaa?
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.hint.0: Ku dar waqtiga ay qaadato (daqiiqado) waqtiga bilowga hawl kasta si aad u hesho waqtiga ay dhammaato.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.hint.1: Sawir heerarka waqtiga ee labada hawlood dhinac-dhinac hal xariiq.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.a: Isbarbar dhig haddii waqtiga bilowga socodka 5:30 uu ka horeeyo ama ka dambeeyo 5:00.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.b: Shaqada guriga 5:00-6:00 iyo socodka 5:30-6:00 dhig dhinac-dhinac xariiq waqti ah.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.c: Hel waqtiyada dhammaadka labada hawlood adigoo ku darraya waqtiga mid walba qaadato waqtiga bilowgeeda.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.d: Kani waa shuruud ku saabsan inta hawshu qaadato, ma aha waqtiga bilowga.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.explain: Shaqada guriga waa 5:00-6:00 socodkuna waa 5:30-6:00, sidaas darteed labada hawlood waxay is dul dhacaan laga bilaabo 5:30 ilaa 6:00. Socodku wuxuu bilaabmaa kadib 5:00 labaduna waxay dhammaadaan ka hor 6:30, sidaas darteed shuruudaha kale waa la ilaaliyey.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.prompt: Samee 3 qorshe oo kala duwan oo ilaaliya dhammaan shuruudaha qoraalka. w waa bilowga socodka k-na waa bilowga shaqada guriga (daqiiqado imisa kadib 4:00 p.m.).
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore go'aami heerka w ee bilowga socodka ay noqon karto, kadibna dooro bilowga shaqada guriga k si uu uga fogaado waqtiga socodkaas.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.hint.1: Hel waqtiga dhammaadka bilowga hawl kasta oo lagu daray waqtiga ay qaadato, oo hubi haddii labada hawlood is dul dhacaan.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Qor w iyo k sida tirooyin buuxa (daqiiqado) oo ah 0 ama ka badan.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.ok.c3: Labada hawlood waxay dhammaadaan ka hor 6:30.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Socodka ama shaqada guriga waxay dhammaataa kadib 6:30.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.ok.c4: Labada hawlood is dul ma dhacaan.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.fail.c4: Waqtiyada socodka iyo shaqada guriga way is dul dhacaan.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.explain: Socodku waa inuu bilaabmaa 60 iyo 120 daqiiqo dhexdooda (5:00-6:00), shaqada guriga-na waa inay bilaabmaan 90 daqiiqo gudahood (ilaa 5:30). Kuwaas dhexdooda, isku-darka aan is dul dhicin ayaa ah jawaabaha. Tusaalooyin: (socod 60, shaqo guri 0), (socod 90, shaqo guri 0), (socod 60, shaqo guri 90).

x-e-e4-03.title: Qoraalka Ken: akhri xariiq xariiq oo qiyaas dareenkiisa
x-e-e4-03.goal: Mar kasta oo aad akhrido xariiq qoraalka ah, mar kale qiyaas waxa saaxiibkaa rabo, oo beddel qiyaasaadkaagii hore tilmaamo cusub.
x-e-e4-03.material: Saaxiibkaa Ken wuxuu soo diray fariin qoraal ah. Waxaa la muujin doonaa hal qaybood mar. Qayb kasta, qiyaas waxa Ken ka rabo.
x-e-e4-03.thinking.0: Beddel qiyaasaadkaaga mar kasta oo tilmaamuhu kordhaan
x-e-e4-03.thinking.1: Ogow in hal weedh oo keliya aysan ku filnayn in lagu sheego
x-e-e4-03.thinking.2: Qor jawaab Ingiriisi ah adigoo u isticmaalaya sababta (tilmaamaha) sida caddayn
x-e-e4-03.prereq.0: Erayo fudud sida cold iyo camp
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.prompt: Akhri qoraalka Ken qayb qayb, oo mar kasta qiyaas waxa Ken rabo.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.hint.0: Hel hal eray ama lambar cusub qaybtan.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.hint.1: Hubi qiyaastaadii hore iyo tilmaamaha cusub, mid mid, si aad u aragto haddii ay weli ku habboon yihiin dhammaantood.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Dooro dhammaan qiyaasaha macquulka ah ee waxa Ken rabo hal sadar kan oo keliya.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Ma ogaan kartid si sax ah hal sadar oo keliya. Wuxuu noqon karaa wuxuu kaliya wadaagayo war, ama wuxuu codsanayo inaad wada ciyaartaan.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Wuxuu rabaa inuu ii sheego warka ah inuu leeyahay ciyaar cusub.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kaliya sheegidda warka sidoo kale waa akhris suurtagal ah.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Wuxuu rabaa inuu ii iibiyo ciyaar.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Waxay u muuqataa inuu doonayo inuu iga codsado inaan la ciyaaro ciyaarta.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Waxaa laga yaabaa inuu rabo inay wada sameeyaan. Hadda, tilmaantu waa qiyaas daciif ah.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Eeg tilmaanta cusub sidoo kale, oo mar kale qiyaas waxa Ken rabo.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Isku darista 'ciyaar laba ciyaartoy' iyo 'walaalkiis wuxuu aadaa xero', akhrinta ugu dabiiciga ah waa inuu raadinayo qof la ciyaaro.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Waxay u muuqataa inuu igu fikirayo sidii qofka labaad ee la ciyaari doono ciyaarta.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Labadaba tilmaanta 'ciyaar laba ciyaartoy' iyo tilmaanta 'walaal ma leh' waxay ku xiran yihiin qiyaastan.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Wuxuu rabaa inuu keligiis ciyaaro ciyaarta.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Wali wuxuu rabaa inuu ii sheego warka oo keliya.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Waxay suurtagal ahayd sadarka koowaad, laakiin hadda oo tilmaanta ah inuusan haysan qof la ciyaaro lagu daray, mar dambe ma sharaxdo dhammaan tilmaamaha.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Eeg tilmaanta ugu dambeysa sidoo kale, oo mar kale qiyaas waxa Ken rabo.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Haddii aad marka hore qiyaastay 'aan wada ciyaarno', hadda waa inaad ka beddesho 'maanta' ilaa 'markii dambe'. Hal tilmaan cusub (hargab, erayada Hooyo) ayaa beddelay qorshaha.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Wuxuu iga codsanayaa inaan maanta imaado gurigiisa oo aan wada ciyaarno.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ma ku habboona tilmaanta ah in hooyadiis tidhi saaxiibbadu maanta guriga ma iman karaan.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Mar dambe ma rabo inuu ila ciyaaro.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wuxuu bixiyay sababta uu 'maya' ugu yiri (hargab, erayada Hooyo), tilmaan ah inuusan rabin inuu ciyaaro ma jirto.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Wuxuu rabaa inuu wada ciyaaro marka uu bogsado.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Hargabku waa sababta, sidaas darteed tani waa akhriska ah inay suurtagal noqon doonto marka hargabku baxo.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.reflect: Saddexdaada qiyaas, halkee ayay ugu badan isbeddeshay? Magacaw hal weedh oo sabab ahayd.
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.prompt: Ku jawaab Ken hal ama laba weedh Ingiriisi ah. Waa inay muujisaa inaad fahamtay waxa Ken rabo.
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore qor hal weedh oo ku saabsan caafimaadka Ken.
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.hint.1: Weedhda labaad, soo jeedi goorta ciyaarta la wada ciyaaro.
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma aqoonsatay hargabka Ken ama ma soo jeedisay in mar dambe la sameeyo?
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma jiraan wax aan ku habboonayn tilmaamihii hore, sida odhashada inaad maanta aadayso gurigiisa?
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.modelNote.1: Jawaab soo jeedisay waqti gaar ah.

x-e-e4-04.title: Maxay email-ka Sora weydiisanayaa?
x-e-e4-04.goal: Go'aami ujeeddada qoraaga email gaaban, adoo caddayn bixinaya, oo ku jawaab Ingiriisi ku habboon ujeeddadaas.
x-e-e4-04.material:
Email Sora u dirtay macallinkeeda (waxaa loo qoray sida qoraal oo keliya, sawir la'aan):

Dear Ms. Park,
I am sorry. I forgot my homework at home. My mom can bring it to school at 11 a.m. today. Is that OK?
Sora

Saddex saaxiib ayaa yiri waxa Sora rabto.
x-e-e4-04.thinking.0: Dooridda sheegashada caddayn ka wanaagsan leh sheegashooyin kala duwan dhexdooda
x-e-e4-04.thinking.2: Jawaabidda si ay ugu habboonaato ujeeddada
x-e-e4-04.prereq.0: Erayo fudud sida homework iyo bring
x-e-e4-04.prereq.1: Taas 'Is that OK?' waa hab lagu weydiiyo oggolaansho
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.prompt: Akhrinta kee ayaa ugu habboon weedhaha email-ka?
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.hint.0: Hubi saddexda akhris weedhaha email-ka, mid mid, oo hel erayada isku dhaca.
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.hint.1: Qor waxa 'bring', 'today', iyo 'Is that OK?' mid walba kuu sheegayaan.
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.o.a: Min: "Sora rabtaa inaysan gacan gelin shaqada guriga."
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.r.a: Raadi haddii email-ku sheegayo inay keeni doonto shaqada guriga.
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.o.b: Jun: "Sora waxay codsanaysaa waqti dheeraad ah ilaa berri."
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.r.b: Hubi eraygee email-ka ku jira, maanta ama berri.
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.o.c: Hana: "Sora waxay weydiisanaysaa haddii ay gacan gelin karto shaqada guriga subaxdan."
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.r.c: Eeg waxa '11 a.m. today' iyo 'Is that OK?' wada tilmaamayaan.
x-e-e4-04.s.s1.explain: 'My mom can bring it ... at 11 a.m. today' wuxuu sheegayaa inay keeni doonto shaqada guriga 11 subaxdan, 'Is that OK?' na wuxuu weydiinayaa haddii taasi fiican tahay. Erayo ku saabsan inaan la gacan gelin ma jiraan, midna ku saabsan codsiga ilaa berri.
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.prompt: Noqo Ms. Park oo ku jawaab Sora hal ama laba weedh Ingiriisi ah. Ka jawaab su'aasha Sora.
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore, ka jawaab su'aasha Sora 'Yes' ama 'No'.
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.hint.1: Weedhda labaad, qor goorta iyo cidda shaqada guriga la siinayo.
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma ka jawaabtay su'aasha Sora (Is that OK?)?
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma qortay waqtiga ama habka keenista shaqada guriga si ay ugu habboonaato email-ka?
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Haddii jawaabtaadu oggolaansho ma bixin, ma qortay sababta?
x-e-e4-04.s.s2.modelNote.1: Jawaab bixisay oggolaansho oo xataa ku darsatay xusuusin mar dambe.

x-e-e4-05.title: Ma aadi karaa Maalinta Filimka?
x-e-e4-05.topic: Dooridda macluumaadka aad u baahan tahay
x-e-e4-05.goal: Kala sooc macluumaadka loo baahan yahay si loo go'aamiyo iyo kuwa aan loo baahnayn, oo ka go'aami macluumaadka aad hesho haddii aad tegi karto.
x-e-e4-05.material:
Ogeysiis ku yaal looxa dugsiga (waxaa loo qoray sida qoraal oo keliya, sawir la'aan):

Movie Day
Friday, after school
Come and watch a movie in the gym.
Bring a snack.

Xaaladda Mina: Jimcaha waa inay guriga joogtaa 6:00 p.m., waxay qaadataa 20 daqiiqo socod laga bilaabo dugsiga ilaa guriga. Lacagta ay kharash gelin karto waa 1,000 won.
x-e-e4-05.thinking.0: Is barbar dhigidda shuruudahayga iyo dooridda macluumaadka runtii loo baahan yahay
x-e-e4-05.thinking.1: Hubinta haddii macluumaadka aad hesho uu buuxiyo dhammaan shuruudaha
x-e-e4-05.thinking.2: Kala saarista macluumaad xiiso leh iyo macluumaad loo baahan yahay
x-e-e4-05.prereq.1: Erayo fudud sida ticket, movie, iyo snack
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.prompt: Dooro dhammaan macluumaadka Mina ay tahay inay macallinka ka weydiiso si ay u go'aamiso haddii ay tegi karto.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore qor labada shuruudood ee Mina, ka dibna hel macluumaadka ogeysiiska ka maqan.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.hint.1: Su'aal kasta, ka fikir haddii jawaabteedu beddeli karto 'tag' ama 'ha tegin'.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.r.a: Macluumaadka aad xiisaysanayso iyo macluumaadka aad u baahan tahay si aad u go'aamiso way kala duwan yihiin. Ka fikir haddii aad hubin karto waqtiga iyo lacagta xataa macluumaadkan la'aantiis.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.r.b: Tani waa macluumaad ku xiran shuruudda waqtiga ee shuruudaha Mina.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.r.c: Tani waa macluumaad ku xiran shuruudda lacagta ee shuruudaha Mina.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.r.d: Ogeysiisku horeyba wuxuu leeyahay 'Bring a snack.' Ka fikir haddii jawaabtani beddesho in ay tegi doonto mise ma tegi doonto.
x-e-e4-05.s.s1.explain: Mina waxay leedahay laba shuruudood, 'guriga gaar 6' iyo '1,000 won', sidaas darteed waxay go'aamin kartaa inay tagto kaliya marka ay ogaato waqtiga filimku dhammaado iyo qiimaha tigidhka. Magaca filimka iyo snack-ga waa wax la xiiso, laakiin ma beddelaan go'aanka.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.prompt: Macallinku wuu jawaabay. "The movie ends at 5:30 p.m. A ticket is 1,500 won." Maxay Mina sameyn kartaa?
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.hint.0: Hubi labada shuruudood si gooni ah, mid mid.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.hint.1: Hubi shuruudda waqtiga adigoo waqtiga socodka ku daraya waqtiga dhammaadka.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.o.a: Lacagta iyo waqtigu labaduba way fiican yihiin, sidaas darteed way tegi kartaa.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.r.a: Hubi haddii aad is barbar dhigtay shuruudda lacagta iyo qiimaha tigidhka lagu siiyay.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.o.b: Marka filimku dhammaado waa daahi doontaa mana gaari karto guriga 6.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.r.b: Ku dar 20-ka daqiiqo ee socodka 5:30 oo ku is barbar dhig 6:00.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.o.c: Waqtigu waa fiican yahay, laakiin lacag ku filan ma haysato.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.r.c: Tani waa fikir hubisay labada shuruudood si gooni ah.
x-e-e4-05.s.s2.explain: Wuxuu dhammaadaa 5:30, iyo socod 20-daqiiqo ah waxay gaadhaa 5:50, taasoo ka hor 6:00. Laakiin tigidhku waa 1,500 won, sidaas darteed ma iibsan karto 1,000 won. Waa inaad hubisaa labada shuruudood.

x-e-e4-06.topic: Dooridda macluumaadka aad u baahan tahay
x-e-e4-06.title: Maxaan weydiin lahaa Ben?
x-e-e4-06.goal: Hel macluumaadka ka maqan qorshe, oo samee laba su'aalood oo Ingiriisi ah adigu si aad u hesho macluumaadkaas.
x-e-e4-06.material:
Ben wuxuu Mina u diray farriin: "Let's do our science homework together on Saturday. Come to my house!"

Xaaladda Mina: Ben wuxuu u guuray guri cusub, Mina-na ma ogtahay halka guriga cusub yaal. Mina waxay leedahay casharka dabaasha Sabtida 10 subaxnimo ilaa 11 subaxnimo.

x-e-e4-07.s.s1.hint.1: Hel sadarkee ayaa leh eraygii ka dhigay labadooda inay u sawirtaan goobo kala duwan.

x-e-e4-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma si dhakhso ah ayaad u sheegi kartaa maktabad kee ay tahay?
x-e-e4-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma ilaaliyay maalinta iyo waqtiga weedhda asalka ah sida ay yihiin?
x-e-e4-07.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma u baahan yahay Ben inuu mar kale weydiiyo ka dib marka uu akhriyo?
x-e-e4-07.s.s2.modelNote.1: Jawaab sheegtay goobta laba siyaabood oo xataa go'aamisay halka lagu kulmo.

x-e-e4-08.s.s1.explain: 'Mina told Sora that she has the glue.', she waxay noqon kartaa Mina ama Sora. Hana iyo Jisu weedha kuma jiraan. Haddii Jisu u akhrido sida Mina, waxay u malaynaysaa Mina ayaa keenaysa.

x-e-e4-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma macnaheedu la mid yahay waxa Mina asal ahaan tiri (Sora ayaa keenaysa)?

x-e-e4-10.topic: Qorista si kala duwan saaxiib iyo macallin
x-e-e4-10.title: U dirista macallin qoraal loo qoray saaxiib
x-e-e4-10.goal: Hel qaybaha qoraal saaxiib ah ee aan macallinka ku habboonayn, oo dib u qor isla xaaladda si ay macallinka ugu habboonaato.
x-e-e4-10.material:
Qoraal loo diray saaxiibka Jisu (ku qoran qoraal oo keliya, sawir la'aan):

"Hey! I'm sick lol. Can't come 2 school 2morrow. Gimme the homework pls!"

(Dhinaca kale, 2morrow waxaa loo akhriyaa 'tu-morrow', hab gaaban oo lagu qoro tomorrow.) Waxaad rabtaa inaad isla nuxurka u dirto macallinkaaga emayl.

x-e-e4-10.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma labada xaaladda (jirrida) iyo codsiga (shaqada guriga) weli way jiraan?
